{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any remaining invalid entries
invalid_after_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'].isna()]
invalid_after_clean_count = len(invalid_after_clean)

# Check if any 'COMPLETED' orders have missing revenue after cleaning
completed_invalid_after_clean = invalid_after_clean[invalid_after_clean['status'] == 'completed']

invalid_after_clean_count, len(completed_invalid_after_clean)"}
